limits: Earlier candidates and all inconclusive rechecks remain recorded. CPU-3 Netpong pairs were pooled without discarding samples but remained inconclusive; the independent CPU-1 recheck resolved that comparison.

The exact source-directory reconstruction is necessary because benchmark panic locations include temporary source paths. Only equal-width compiler bundle prefixes are masked; all other bytes and layout match the measured artifacts.
The small-count artifact checks are not runtime performance measurements. No samples are fabricated or copied between runs.
Instruction counts diagnose compiler work and do not replace timing acceptance. Three samples of each variant were counted on CPU 1, user-space only, without multiplexing.
The initial 85k and final roughly 67k root lines/CPU-second reflect different host load conditions. The 250k compilation and C/Rust runtime goals remain unmet.
